title: Reading the drying room’s reports
titleZh: 判讀公共烘衣間的回報

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: A short update on our shared dryers. When only one machine takes longer than usual, tell us its number. Last week, dryer three took longer because its lint filter was blocked. On Sunday, every machine took longer, even with clean filters. The air coming in from outside was very damp. Report a slow room separately from a slow machine. If several dryers are slow, tell us when you noticed it, not just which dryer you happened to use. That helps us compare reports.
turns.zh: 共用烘衣設備簡短更新：如果只有一台比平常慢，請告訴我們它的編號。上週三號機烘得比較久，是因為棉絮濾網堵住。週日則是每一台都較慢，即使濾網乾淨也一樣。當時從室外進來的空氣很潮濕。整間烘衣室都慢和單機慢，請分開回報。好幾台都慢時，請告訴我們你是何時發現的，不要只寫自己剛好用的那台。這樣我們才能比對各筆回報。
